text.tspan: VAE (MNIST fully connected) | Operators & tensor flow
MNIST 784 / hidden 500 / latent 15 / independent posterior heads / read bottom to top
B: batch; image 1x28x28 -> caller flatten 784; latent width 15
input pink / forward return purple / LeakyReLU and exponential gray / Sigmoid green
side routes retain tuple fields; epsilon side route is an internal random source
Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.
E### = source span (hover a module); dashed = named state / auxiliary input; fork-join = tuple/list, not sum.
Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.
